change: Process environment duplicate validation and inherited merge: sorted name index replaces repeated scans.

algorithm.common: Validate names and values, sort borrowed string_view names, adjacent duplicate check. Inline16 entries; fallible AllocatorRef reserve larger than16.
algorithm.posix: Exact case names sorted in inline16 Scratch index; one strchr per inherited entry plus binary_search; original appended-change order remains.
algorithm.windows: Sort existing UTF16 WideChange metadata using length then original CompareStringOrdinal(TRUE), reject adjacent equal names and lower_bound inherited names. Original special-name extraction and full-entry ordinal output sort remain; no additional native index allocation.
algorithm.complexity: O(M log M + E log M) name work, plus Windows pre-existing final output sort; compared with common M(M-1)/2 and native E*M scans.

correctness.added_or_expanded: 128-change replacement and inherited/unset, large duplicate then runtime retry, Windows Unicode ordinal case equivalence vs POSIX exact case distinction, common index allocation failure and successful retry with balanced allocator.
correctness.native_count_fixture: M16 control and M1024 representative; E=M+2 regular inherited entries, half changed names match existing, every third change unset. Windows adds one inherited =C: special entry. Exact serialized old/new environment blocks compared. Unicode case equivalence/distinction is separately covered by the canonical Process test, not this count fixture.
correctness.small_index_allocation: Common validation allocator calls are0 on both sides at16 changes; candidate1024 calls1, baseline0.

counts_method: make_count_probe.py extracts the exact actual source validation and environment-builder functions from frozen baseline/canonical candidate, instruments name-comparison/strchr sites, substitutes only inherited-environment acquisition with fixed arrays. Windows name count includes duplicate/equality/lookup comparisons, excludes unchanged final full-output ordering comparisons. POSIX count includes sort/lookup comparisons or old name-match attempts. These are operations, not elapsed time or public API count guarantees.
limits: No spawn-time benchmark or external-peer ranking; this fixes a source-confirmed complexity issue without claiming a measured end-to-end speedup.
macOS Process was not built or run; it shares changed process_posix.cc but its native runtime was not validated this round.
Zero-change inherited default path already bypasses environment packing; this change does not claim that default spawn previously paid E*M.
Additional common scratch allocation for more than16 changes may fail with ResourceExhausted before child admission; regression confirms typed failure and retry.
Validation now checks all name/value fields before sorted duplicate detection; when multiple inputs are malformed, the InvalidArgument message precedence may differ.
No full library build, CMake configure, dependency download or SDK copy. Current cached foundation library hashes/loader paths are in windows-identity.json and wsl-identity.json.
